notes_for_editor: Only one source was found: the provincial tower layer, which gives a name, a fire-tower class, a position and a location accuracy. No construction date, height, design, status, access or history turned up in any source checked, and one web search for McConnell 2 returned nothing relevant. The story is about 80 words, below the 120-word guide floor, because the evidence supports no more without padding. It is not on the still-standing list that covers the McConnell Fire Tower (ca-on-mcconnell). Worth checking Forest History Ontario or Ontario fire-tower histories before publication; a human should decide whether a short entry is worth publishing.
